title: Fix bugs in a Python statistics module
description: A Python statistics module has three bugs: mean divides by wrong count, median doesn't handle even-length lists, and variance uses wrong formula. Fix all three.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the three bugs in stats.py:

1. BUG in mean(): Change `/ 1` to `/ len(numbers)`
2. BUG in median(): For even-length lists, return the average of the two middle elements: `(s[mid-1] + s[mid]) / 2`
3. BUG in variance(): Change `/ (len(numbers) - 1)` to `/ len(numbers)` for population variance

Run `pytest test_stats.py -v --rootdir=.` to verify all 6 tests pass.
success_criteria: median averages two middle values for even lists
variance uses population formula (divide by n)
followup_prompts: Run `pytest test_stats.py -v --rootdir=.` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `pytest test_stats.py -v --rootdir=.` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
